Metabolic alkalosis
F. How do his diagnoses relate to this acid-base imbalance?
 Renal insuﬃ  ciency can result in low serum bicarbon-
ate levels, thus causing metabolic alkalosis. Obstructive 
pulmonary disease can decrease the patient’s ability to
expire CO2, subsequently leading to respiratory acidosis.
It is not related to this acid-base imbalance of metabolic 
alkalosis.
